title: Split setup_night_lockdown.sh under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring linux_configuration/scripts/periodic_background/digital_wellbeing/setup_night_lockdown.sh (918 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving config, systemd-unit generation and the subcommands into five sourced libs, and externalizing the two large generated scripts as data-file payloads -- while emitting byte-identical artifacts to the ones already deployed in /usr/local/bin on this machine.
acceptance_criteria: The entry script and all five lib/nl_*.sh files are each at most 250 lines.
`help`, `status` and an unknown-command run are byte-identical to the pre-split baselines, with exit codes 0, 0 and 1.
The artifacts emitted by install_enter_script and install_unlock_script are mode 0755 and sha256-identical to the live /usr/local/bin/night-lockdown-{enter,unlock}.sh.
A line-multiset check accounts for every functional line of the 918-line original, with the only differences being the six lines the heredoc-to-data-file conversion replaces.
The payload files are not reformatted by the pre-commit shfmt pass, since any byte change there breaks the hash equality above.
shellcheck passes without -x on the entry script and libs, and shfmt -w is a no-op on all of them, with no suppression added.
The live deployed artifacts are unchanged by the work: sha256sum -c passes at the end.
out_of_scope: Running `setup` or `unlock`: they write /etc/systemd/system, enable timers and reconfigure the machine's night lockdown.
Re-deploying to /usr/local/bin -- unnecessary, since the split emits the bytes already there.
Shell test coverage for the new libs; no suite exists for this script.
Any change to the lockdown schedule, the monitored units, or the RGB/i2c behaviour.
verifier: bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all for the cap; diff of help/status/unknown against captured baselines; a scratch-directory run of install_enter_script and install_unlock_script with sha256 comparison against the live deployed copies; a python3 line-multiset diff including the payload files; shellcheck, shfmt idempotence and bash -n; sha256sum -c on the deployed artifacts as the final step; pre-commit run --files on the staged set.
